newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX seeks pay phone increase in 3 states.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX seeks pay phone increase in 3 states.

text.p: NYNEX Corp on Friday said it was seeking to increase its pay telephone rate to $0.25 for local calls in Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Vermont, where calls now cost $0.10.
The company said it hopes to increase the rate in early April as part of the new Federal Communications Commission rules.
NYNEX said the rate changes would lead to appropriate offsetting adjustments in the rates for other services.
Details of those adjustments are to be filed in Masachusetts with the company's annual price cap filing in June, it said.
In Vermont and New Hamsphire, details would be contained in documents to be filed with the state regulatory commission in the coming weeks.
The $0.10 phone rate was set in 1955 in those three New England states.

NYNEX said the new FCC rules, under the Telecommunications Act of 1996, are designed to encourage pay telephone competition, require market-based pricing and provide fair compensation for all pay phone providers.
